steps.content: You dust off your hands and stand up by supporting yourself on your knees. You discover a generator in the storage cabinet located in the corner of the living room. It's working well and looks like it can last a few more days.
Didn't expect she even has a generator at home, probably not the first time she forgot to pay the bill.
But judging by the thick layer of the dust, she must have forgotten about this thing.
Don't know how much power is left, but it'll have to do for now...
Must make sure Angell earns enough money to pay the bill before this generator runs out of power as well.
You gather the cardboard boxes that tripped you and stash them in the cabinet. Then, you pick up the clothes knotted together and try your best to untangle them.
Where did these clothes come from? They weren't here when I cleaned the living room a couple of days ago...
Never mind, might as well wash them later...
Right, she mentioned that the gig she took on today turned out to be a fake again. Now that there's power, you should look into that...
Beep... Beep...
Just as you're about to log on to the dark web, the comms device rings suddenly.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Found the generator?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes. It'll last for a while, but we still need to pay the bill.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I know. Just take a few gigs from my regulars. They're all lined up waiting, and they pay well.
You look at the DisMyth site on the screen, unsure which accounts are her "regulars," but scrolling through the countless orders on the commission board...

The ones offering generous payments are almost always assassination gigs, either targeting a prey or a hunter. These are not uncommon on DisMyth, and sometimes the job details are so horrendous that they make you sick just by reading them.

If possible, you don't want to be reminded of those bloody businesses every time you see your roommate. You're already walking a tightrope here, pushing it any further might just push you over the edge.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're not that in need of money, right? I'd rather pick some gigs that are safer and more acceptable, even if they pay less. We'll make enough to cover the bill eventually.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We better keep a low profile to avoid trouble for now.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Alright then. I'll wait for your update.
